recipe.visualDefinition: A soft-focus 1960s-style portrait featuring a woman seated in a white wicker peacock chair adorned with daisies, set against a hazy, ethereal background with prominent top-right aligned psychedelic typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The circular arc of the chair frames the subject's head and shoulders.
The text block in the upper right balances the visual weight of the subject.
Soft white haze at the bottom creates a dreamlike, floating effect.
The olive green of the text echoes the natural tones of the flower stems.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally but positioned in the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The woman's face and the large circular back of the chair.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves up to the decorative chair back, then right to the stylized text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample soft-focus space around the chair and a misty foreground at the bottom edge.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white and cream (chair, dress, background haze)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high-key lighting, creating a faded vintage look.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to muted earth tones and pastels

letterConstructionRules: Tight letter spacing with occasional ligatures
Small x-height relative to overall glyph width
characterSpecificRedesigns: The dot of the 'i' is replaced by a small daisy graphic
Horizontal bars on 'E' and 'L' are elongated and wavy
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A highly stylized display face paired with a tiny, clean sans-serif for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the organic, flowing nature of the strokes

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A soft-focus studio portrait of a woman with 60s hair sitting in a white wicker peacock chair decorated with daisies. The bottom of the frame is obscured by a thick white mist. Muted pastel color palette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add stylized, wide, Art Nouveau-inspired green text in the top right corner. Ensure the 'i' has a daisy dot. Add small technical metadata in the top corners with horizontal arrows.

verificationChecks: Is the text color a muted olive green?
Does the chair have a distinct peacock-style circular back?
Is the lighting soft and diffused with a hazy foreground?

adjustableVariables: Density of daisies on the chair
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles
Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the subject's head.
Check that the wicker texture is visible but soft.
Verify the bottom mist looks like a physical effect, not a digital gradient.
Confirm the typography maintains a heavy horizontal stress.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a [Subject] in a [White Wicker Peacock Chair] with [Daisy Accents] + [Soft Focus Pastel Background] + [Top-Right Aligned Psychedelic Typography in Olive Green].
